notes: Evals 1-2 run on a bare Next.js scaffold; eval 3 on an Express scaffold (not Next.js). Evals 4-5 run on a COPY of fixtures/ai-studio-prototype (strip its README.md from the copy first — it is the answer key) — a real Google-AI-Studio-shaped project (own shell, teal brand, Tailwind v3, better-sqlite3 store, fake login); they exist because the 2026-09-09 field bug was never covered: earlier evals told the model the situation in the prompt and asserted on recorded decisions, never on the outcome (tokens rebased? store migrated? one shell?). Part of this skill's output lives in the transcript (child-skill invocation order, interview questions), not in files — the grader must read the transcript, not only the produced files. Prompts are intentionally kept in Thai: they simulate what org users actually type.
